Liquidity view: TDG generated positive operating cash of USD752m in fiscal Q1, but shareholder payments, rather than an operating cash loss, drove the decline from September cash of USD6261m to USD2459m at December 28, 2024. Issuer-reported cash liquidity of USD3308m is a meaningful historical counterweight, not independently certified accessible liquidity. The remaining dated funding question is the July 11, 2025 securitization expiry, now against December principal of USD650m rather than September principal of USD487m; March and September hedge transitions also require payment-level planning. The historical conclusion is positive operating cash generation and a retained cash buffer after substantial distributions. Complete 13-week/12-month sufficiency and minimum-cash runway remain unproven. Source gate: Ready with Limitations. Forward Liquidity Risk Level: Insufficient Information.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: **Forward formula semantics:** the method's expanded formula is applicable only if “operating cash” is a pre-WC, pre-interest, pre-tax and pre-lease operating base and those components are then fully modeled once. If the input is **reported-OCF-basis forecast**, ending cash = beginning accessible cash + forecast OCF − capex − debt/finance-lease principal − other investing/distribution/other financing uses not included in OCF + actual supported financing inflows + applicable cash FX. Working capital, cash interest, tax, operating-lease cash, finance-lease operating-interest cash and operating derivative settlements are already within OCF and must not be subtracted again. Reported OCF is not supplied as a forward forecast here. Revolver capacity must not be added to cash and then counted again as proceeds: track drawn cash/remaining availability separately, adjusting capacity for conditions, repayment and maturity. Renewing existing securitization principal is not a fresh cash inflow unless it actually releases additional proceeds. Any separate pre-interest/pre-tax build would require a complete alternative operating model; none is invented.
